# Telemetry

`c.Telemetry` calls the API's Telemetry group. Telemetry through the controller,
such as the spans of a trace.

## Methods

| Method                         | Returns                    | Permission   | Description               |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------- |
| [`Get(ctx, id, params)`](#get) | `*Response[TraceResponse]` | `trace:read` | Get the spans of a trace. |

### Get

```go
func (s *TelemetryService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	id string,
	params TelemetryGetParams,
) (*Response[TraceResponse], error)
```

Get the spans of a trace.

Returns each span of a trace, read from the tracing backend at
telemetry.tracing.url. The backend gets the spans a few seconds after the
request, so a trace of a request that just ran can be not found yet. A token
with a target scope gets a trace only when each target that the trace records is
in its scope.

It sends `GET /api/telemetry/trace/{id}`, and needs the permission `trace:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Get the spans of a trace, `go run telemetry.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Telemetry.Get(ctx, "26e448c9dbe1c4a8d216a98c675079c9", client.TelemetryGetParams{})
```

Get the spans of a trace, with --id 26e448c9dbe1c4a8d216a98c675079c9 --all,
`go run telemetry.go get-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Telemetry.Get(ctx, "26e448c9dbe1c4a8d216a98c675079c9", client.TelemetryGetParams{All: true})
```

## Types

The fields of each type are the properties of its schema in the API's spec.

### SpanStatus

SpanStatus is whether the work of a span failed.

A `string`, one of `ok`, `error`.

### TraceNode

| Field       | Type          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Children`  | `[]TraceNode` | The spans under this one, in start order.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `ClockSkew` | `string`      | How far the span and the spans under it were moved forward, as a Go duration, because the span started before its parent: the clock of its host is behind. Empty when the span was not moved. |
| `Detail`    | `string`      | What the span acted on, as key=value pairs, led by error= on a failed span.                                                                                                                   |
| `Duration`  | `string`      | How long the span took, as a Go duration.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `Name`      | `string`      | The name of the span, such as job.process.                                                                                                                                                    |
| `On`        | `string`      | What ran the span: the role of its service, such as controller, agent or cli.                                                                                                                 |
| `Span`      | `TraceSpan`   |                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `Status`    | `string`      | The job's status on a job.process, changed or unchanged on a behavior write, and ok or error on other spans.                                                                                  |

### TraceResponse

| Field         | Type          | Description                                                                          |
| ------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `Duration`    | `string`      | From the start of the first span to the end of the last, as a Go duration.           |
| `FailedSpans` | `int`         | The number of spans that failed.                                                     |
| `NATSCalls`   | `int`         | The number of NATS calls left out, the bookkeeping of the job queue. all shows them. |
| `NATSTime`    | `string`      | The time that the NATS calls left out took, as a Go duration.                        |
| `Services`    | `[]string`    | The services that made the spans, in the order each first appears.                   |
| `Spans`       | `[]TraceNode` | The spans that have no parent in the trace, each with its children, in start order.  |
| `Started`     | `time.Time`   | When the first span started.                                                         |
| `TraceID`     | `string`      | The trace ID.                                                                        |

### TraceSpan

| Field           | Type                | Description                                                  |
| --------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `Attributes`    | `map[string]string` | The attributes of the span, each as text.                    |
| `DurationMS`    | `float64`           | How long the span took, in milliseconds.                     |
| `Kind`          | `string`            | The span kind, such as server, client, producer or consumer. |
| `Name`          | `string`            | The name of the span, such as job.process.                   |
| `ParentSpanID`  | `string`            | The ID of the parent span. Empty for the root.               |
| `Service`       | `string`            | The service that made the span, such as osapi-agent.         |
| `SpanID`        | `string`            | The span ID.                                                 |
| `StartTime`     | `time.Time`         | When the span started.                                       |
| `Status`        | `SpanStatus`        | SpanStatus is whether the work of a span failed.             |
| `StatusMessage` | `string`            | The error of a failed span.                                  |
